create_meteor_instance: create a METEOR evaluation instance to compute translation quality scores via subprocess
compute_score_gts_res: compute METEOR scores for ground truth and result caption dictionaries keyed by image IDs
score_hypothesis_reference: score a single hypothesis string against a list of reference strings using the METEOR evaluator
get_meteor_method_name: get the METEOR evaluation method name string from the Meteor class instance
exit_meteor_subprocess: exit and clean up the METEOR subprocess and release its resources
